ios.debug.small.build: cd ../../apps/obi-mobile/ios && xcodebuild -workspace Mobile.xcworkspace -scheme Mobile -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone SE (3rd generation)' -derivedDataPath ./build -quiet

ios.debug.large.build: cd ../../apps/obi-mobile/ios && xcodebuild -workspace Mobile.xcworkspace -scheme Mobile -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 14 Pro Max' -derivedDataPath ./build -quiet
